name: Passaic County, NJ
findings: Passaic County has 1,504 nonprofit organizations. 544 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 430 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Passaic County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few professional organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 3 professional organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 10 would.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through professional groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 222 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 222 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few research and think tank organizations list public events
observations.text: 1 research and think tank organization here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.
